text.tspan: Reaction evidence reﬁnes a broad family annotation
Saved discovery case: distinct nitrogen donors lead to diﬀerent search priorities.
a broad GS-fold annotation cannot determine nitrogen-donor speciﬁcity. Search
deprioritization is reversible and does not demonstrate inactivity on the target substrates.
Evaluate the native reacting partners; avoid assigning one substrate scope to an entire fold.
Archived September 17 run, events 51 and 122–125; reconstructed from saved decisions. Kurihara et al. (2008), PMID:18495664.
